title: Zombie Scenario - Freeze time music
summary: The pre-round (freeze time) theme used across Zombie Scenario: Season 2 chapters.
description: The Zombie Scenario: Season 2 page lists its soundtrack in three categories - 'Freeze time music', 'Survival music' and 'Pursuit and Boss music' - with four tracks in total. The freeze-time cue plays during the buy/preparation phase before each round of Toxicity, Culvert, Decoy, Angra Nest and Poisoning. File names and titles were not exposed by the digest; the wiki's Category:Sounds and Category:Music pages (which hold the audio files) could not be fetched.
